newsitem.title: CHINA: China says welcomes Korea four-party talks.
newsitem.headline: China says welcomes Korea four-party talks.

text.p: China said on Wednesday it supported efforts to create a peace mechanism for the Korean peninsula and welcomed the prospect of four-party talks.

"We approve of establishing a peace mechanism for the Korean peninsula and take a positive attitude toward the four-party talks," the official Xinhua news agency quoted Foreign Ministry spokesman Tang Guoqiang as saying.
China had agreed to take part in the talks and would take a constructive role in efforts to create a peace mechanism to bring long-term peace and stability to the Korean peninsula, Tang said.
North and South Korea as well as China and the United States plan to meet in New York in August to decide on an agenda and other procedural details for formal peace talks.
The famine-hit North on Monday agreed to attend the talks aimed at reaching a peace treaty to replace the armistice that ended the 1950-53 Korean War.
China backed North Korea in the Korean conflict against the South and U.S.-led United Nations forces
